metadata.title: Q&A Session (If Needed)
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Conduct a Q&A session with the user only if genuine ambiguities exist after sniffing. This step is conditional and may produce no output if acceptance criteria are clear, code aligns with requirements, and no critical ambiguities were found.

output.description: Resolved answers to ambiguous questions, or confirmation that no Q&A was needed

prerequisites: Sniffing findings stored in memory (scopeAndImpact, risks, requirementsVsCode)
Work item details available in memory
specificActions: Follow the substeps below in sequence
First evaluate if Q&A is actually needed before asking any questions
Skip Q&A if: AC are clear and specific, code aligns with requirements, no critical ambiguities found in sniffing
If Q&A is needed, classify questions into two categories:
must-ask: Ambiguous AC with multiple valid interpretations that would change test case content
assume-and-note: Test data specifics, environment details, non-functional requirements (assume reasonable defaults and note assumptions)
Each question should be presented as a separate interaction with 3-4 specific options plus an 'Other' fallback
Do NOT ask 'which environments should be tested?' as a blanket question
This step is conditional and may produce no output if no Q&A is needed

read: memory.json (for sniffing findings, work item details, requirements vs code mapping)

tools: AskQuestion - Present each question with multiple choice options
bestPractices: Prefer skipping Q&A over asking unnecessary questions
Only ask questions whose answers would materially change the test plan
Provide concrete options for each question, not open-ended prompts
Include 'Other' as a fallback option for every question
Group assume-and-note items into a summary rather than individual questions
Log the decision of whether Q&A was needed and why

substeps.name: Evaluate if Q&A is needed
substeps.description: Assess whether genuine ambiguities exist that require user input
actions: Review sniffing findings, especially requirementsVsCode mapping
Check if acceptance criteria are clear and specific
Check if code changes align with requirements
Check if any critical ambiguities were flagged during sniffing
Decision: If AC are clear, code aligns, and no critical ambiguities -> skip Q&A (set qaSession.needed = false)
Decision: If genuine ambiguities exist that would change test case content -> proceed with Q&A
Log the evaluation reasoning

substeps.name: Formulate questions (if needed)
substeps.description: Classify and formulate questions for must-ask and assume-and-note categories
actions: Classify ambiguities into must-ask and assume-and-note categories
must-ask: Ambiguous AC with multiple valid interpretations that change test case content
assume-and-note: Test data specifics, environment details, non-functional requirements
For each must-ask question: formulate with 3-4 specific options plus 'Other' fallback
For assume-and-note items: document the assumption that will be made
Do NOT include blanket questions like 'which environments should be tested?'

substeps.name: Present questions to user
substeps.description: Ask each must-ask question as a separate interaction
actions: Present each must-ask question as a separate AskQuestion interaction
Each question must have 3-4 concrete options plus 'Other' fallback
Wait for user response to each question
Record each answer
Present assume-and-note summary: list assumptions being made, ask user to flag any that are incorrect

substeps.name: Update context with resolved answers
substeps.description: Store resolved answers and assumptions in memory
actions: Store all resolved answers in memory under qaSession.resolvedAnswers
Store assumptions from assume-and-note items
Update any sniffing findings that are affected by the answers
Log the Q&A session outcome

substeps.name: End-Step: Compliance Check
substeps.description: Verify principles were followed in this step
actions: Verify: Was log.json updated for any user interactions?
Verify: Q&A decision was logged (needed or skipped with reasoning)
Verify: Were mandatory actions confirmed with output?
Output: 'Step completed in compliance with operating principles'

flow.description: Evaluate if Q&A is needed -> If not needed: log reasoning and skip to compliance check -> If needed: formulate questions (must-ask + assume-and-note) -> Present each must-ask question individually -> Update context with answers. Substeps 1-3 are conditional and only execute if genuine ambiguities exist.

memoryFileUsage.readFrom: Sniffing findings (requirementsVsCode, risks, scopeAndImpact), work item details
memoryFileUsage.writeTo: qaSession object with needed flag, questions asked, resolved answers
fields: Information Produced: qaSession.needed (boolean), qaSession.questions (if any), qaSession.resolvedAnswers (if any), qaSession.assumptions (assume-and-note items)
Decisions Made: Whether Q&A was needed (with reasoning), answer to each question
Notes: Assumptions made for assume-and-note items, any user corrections
